en.s: The Battle of Raphia was fought on 22 June 217 BC near modern Rafah between the forces of Ptolemy IV Philopator, king and pharaoh of Ptolemaic Egypt and Antiochus III the Great of the Seleucid Empire during the Syrian Wars. It was one of the largest battles of the Hellenistic kingdoms and of the ancient world, and determined the sovereignty of Coele-Syria.

zh.s: 拉菲亚战役于公元前217年6月22日在今拉法附近爆发，交战双方是托勒密埃及国王兼法老托勒密四世·菲洛帕托和塞琉古帝国安条克三世，属于叙利亚战争。这是希腊化王国和古代世界规模最大的战役之一，决定了科埃勒叙利亚的归属。

en.s: The Battle of Pydna took place in 168 BC between Rome and Macedon during the Third Macedonian War. The battle saw the further ascendancy of Rome in the Hellenistic world and the end of the Antigonid line of kings, whose power traced back to Alexander the Great's Diadochi Antigonus Monophthalmus. The battle is also considered to be a victory of the Roman legion's manipular system's flexibility over the Antigonid Macedonian phalanx's rigidity.

zh.s: 皮德纳战役发生于公元前168年，是罗马与马其顿王国在第三次马其顿战争期间的一场战斗。此战进一步确立了罗马在希腊化世界的优势，并终结了安提柯王朝的统治。该王朝的权力可追溯至亚历山大大帝的继业者之一安提柯一世。此战也被视为罗马军团灵活的操阵方式战胜安提柯王朝马其顿方阵僵化战术的例子。

en.s: Bulgarian Battle of Versinikia (Bulgarian: Битката при Версиникия; Greek: Μάχη της Βερσινικίας) was a battle fought in 813 AD between the Byzantine Empire and the Bulgarian Empire, near the city of Adrianople (Edirne), in modern-day Turkey. The Bulgarian army, led by Krum of Bulgaria, defeated the Byzantine forces. Following this defeat, Michael I Rangabe abdicated, with Leo V the Armenian taking the Byzantine throne.

zh.s: 韦尔西尼基亚战役（保加利亚语：Битката при Версиникия；希腊语：Μάχη της Βερσινικίας）于公元813年爆发，交战双方为拜占庭帝国和保加利亚帝国，战场靠近阿德里安堡（今土耳其埃迪尔内）。保加利亚国王克鲁姆率军击败拜占庭军队。拜占庭战败后，米海尔一世·兰加贝退位，亚美尼亚人利奥五世继位。

en.s: The Battle of Rednitz on 22 June 910, was a decisive victory of the Magyar cavalry over the East Francian - German kingdoms armies. The location of this battle could be not determined with 100% certitude. The battle happened near the river Rednitz, in Franconia, near the border with Bavaria ("in confinio Bavariae et Franciae"). After the battle, the German king Louis the Child, together with the Swabian, Frankish, Bavarian and Saxonian dukes, accepted to pay tribute to the Hungarian state.

zh.s: 雷德尼茨战役于910年6月22日爆发，马扎尔骑兵大败东法兰克王国及德意志诸邦军队。战役的确切地点尚不能完全确定；据称发生在弗兰肯地区雷德尼茨河附近、巴伐利亚与弗兰肯边界一带。战后，幼王路易与施瓦本、弗兰肯、巴伐利亚和萨克森公爵接受向匈牙利纳贡。

en.s: The siege of Coimbra of 1117 was a military engagement between the forces of the Almoravid dynasty and those of the County of Portugal in the city of Coimbra. In 1117, the Almoravids launched a campaign into the County of Portugal to attack the city of Coimbra and withdrew after failing to capture it.

zh.s: 1117年的科英布拉围城战是阿尔摩拉维王朝军队与葡萄牙伯国军队在科英布拉进行的一场军事冲突。1117年，阿尔摩拉维王朝军队出兵葡萄牙伯国，试图攻占科英布拉，未能得手后撤退。

en.s: The Scaliger War was a conflict fought in 1336–1339 between the Scaliger lords of Verona, Mastino II della Scala and Alberto II della Scala, who had built an extensive territorial state in northern Italy, and a coalition of powers threatened by Scaliger expansion. These were chiefly the Republic of Venice, antagonized by the imposition of taxes on overland trade and the Scaligers' threat to end Venetian salt monopoly, and the Republic of Florence, which resented the Scaliger annexation of Lucca, that Florence had claimed for itself.

zh.s: 1336年至1339年，维罗纳的斯卡利杰领主马斯蒂诺二世和阿尔贝托二世扩张领地，引发斯卡利杰战争。威尼斯共和国反对其对陆路贸易征税并威胁打破威尼斯的盐业垄断；佛罗伦萨则不满斯卡利杰家族吞并其声称拥有的卢卡。

en.s: The Battle of Bryn Glas (also known as the Battle of Pilleth) was a battle between the Welsh and English on 22 June 1402, near the towns of Knighton and Presteigne in Powys, Wales. It was part of the Glyndŵr rebellion of 1400-1415. It was an important victory for the Welsh under Owain Glyndŵr, as it resulted in the prolongation of the Welsh war of independence and the destabilisation of English politics for several years afterward.

zh.s: 布林格拉斯战役也称皮利斯战役，于1402年6月22日在威尔士波伊斯郡奈顿和普雷斯泰因附近爆发，交战双方是威尔士人和英格兰人。战斗属于1400年至1415年的格林多尔起义。欧文·格林多尔率领威尔士军获胜，延长了威尔士独立战争，并使英格兰政局数年动荡。

en.s: The Battle of Nesbit Moor (or Nisbet Muir) was a small but significant clash between Scottish and English forces in the borders area north of the River Tweed. Specifically this clash took place on the Kimmerghame Estate in a field now named Slaughter Field. The estate is in the possession of the Swinton Family. In 1402, Scottish nobles launched a coordinated invasion of Northern England.

zh.s: 内斯比特沼泽战役（又称尼斯贝特沼泽战役）是苏格兰与英格兰军队在特威德河以北边境地区发生的一场规模不大但影响重要的冲突。战斗具体发生在金默格姆庄园的一块田地里，如今这块田被称为“屠杀田”。庄园由斯温顿家族持有。1402年，苏格兰贵族联合入侵英格兰北部。

en.s: The Battle of Morat ((French: Bataille de Morat; German: Schlacht bei Murten) took place during the Burgundian Wars (1474–1477) that was fought on 22 June 1476 between Charles the Bold, the Duke of Burgundy, and a Swiss Confederation army at Morat (Murten), about 30 kilometres from Bern. It was the second major engagement of the Burgundian Wars, and ended in a crippling defeat for Charles the Bold.

zh.s: 穆尔滕战役（法语：Bataille de Morat；德语：Schlacht bei Murten）于1476年6月22日爆发，是1474年至1477年勃艮第战争的一部分。勃艮第公爵大胆查理与瑞士邦联军队在距伯尔尼约30公里的莫拉（德语称穆尔滕）交战。这是勃艮第战争中的第二场重大战役，大胆查理遭到惨败。

en.s: The conquest of Sunda Kelapa was launched by the Sultanate of Demak against the Sundanese kingdom in the west of Java. The city was successfully conquered and was later renamed Jayakarta (Jakarta).

zh.s: 德马克苏丹国向爪哇岛西部的巽他王国发动攻势，征服了巽他格拉巴。该城随后改名为查雅加达（今雅加达）。

en.s: The Battle of Sirhind was fought between the Mughal Empire and the Sur Empire in 1555.

en.s: The Battle of Sisak (Croatian: Bitka kod Siska; Slovene: Bitka pri Sisku; German: Schlacht bei Sissek; Turkish: Kulpa Bozgunu) was fought on 22 June 1593 between Ottoman regional forces of Telli Hasan Pasha, a notable commander (Beglerbeg) of the Eyalet of Bosnia, and a combined Christian army from the Habsburg lands, mainly Kingdom of Croatia and Inner Austria. The battle took place at Sisak, central Croatia, at the confluence of the rivers Sava and Kupa. Earlier in 1591 and 1592 the Ottomans had two failed attempts of capturing the Sisak fortress, but managed to take the strategically important fortress of Bihać in 1592.

zh.s: 锡萨克战役于1593年6月22日爆发，交战双方是波斯尼亚省贝勒贝伊、奥斯曼指挥官泰利·哈桑帕夏率领的地方部队，以及由哈布斯堡领地组成的基督教联军，主力来自克罗地亚王国和内奥地利。战斗发生在克罗地亚中部锡萨克、萨瓦河与库帕河交汇处。奥斯曼军曾于1591年和1592年两次试图攻占锡萨克要塞，均告失败，但在1592年夺取了具有战略意义的比哈奇要塞。

en.t: Galileo is sentenced by the Roman Inquisition
en.s: The Roman Inquisition pronounced its judgment against Galileo Galilei after proceedings concerning his defense of a moving Earth and a Sun-centered planetary system. Galileo was found vehemently suspected of heresy and required to recant the positions at issue. His sentence of imprisonment was later commuted to house arrest, under which he spent the remainder of his life. The case followed the publication of his Dialogue Concerning the Two Chief World Systems and involved questions of scriptural interpretation, authority, and scientific argument. It remains a major episode in discussions of the relationship between religious institutions and the development of early modern science.

zh.t: 伽利略被罗马宗教裁判所判刑
zh.s: 罗马宗教裁判所在审理伽利略·伽利莱捍卫地球运动和日心行星体系的观点后作出裁决，认定他“强烈涉嫌异端”，并要求他撤回相关主张。伽利略被判监禁，后来改为软禁，余生都在软禁中度过。此案发生在他出版《关于托勒密和哥白尼两大世界体系的对话》之后，涉及经文解释、权威与科学论证等问题。它至今仍是讨论宗教机构与近代科学发展关系的重要历史事件。

en.s: The Battle of Tornavento was a battle fought in Italy on June 22, 1636 during the Thirty Years' War. In 1636, Cardinal Richelieu had persuaded the Duke of Savoy (Vittorio Amedeo I) to launch an offensive on the Spanish Duchy of Milan. A French Army crossed the Ticino river between Oleggio and Lonate Pozzolo, but was checked by a larger Spanish army, and dug in to await their Savoyard allies.On June 22 the Spanish attacked, but were held back after the arrival of the army of Victor Amadeus I, Duke of Savoy.

zh.s: 托尔纳文托战役于1636年6月22日在意大利爆发，属于三十年战争。黎塞留枢机说服萨伏依公爵维托里奥·阿梅迪奥一世进攻西班牙控制的米兰公国。法军在奥莱焦和洛纳泰波佐洛之间渡过提契诺河，却被人数更多的西班牙军队阻挡，只得固守等待萨伏依盟军。6月22日，西班牙军发起进攻，但萨伏依公爵维托里奥·阿梅迪奥一世率军赶到后，西军被击退。

en.s: The Battle of Bothwell Bridge, or Bothwell Brig, took place on 22 June 1679. It was fought between government troops and militant Presbyterian Covenanters, and signalled the end of their brief rebellion. The battle took place at the bridge over the River Clyde in Hamilton, South Lanarkshire near Bothwell in Lanarkshire, Scotland. The battlefield has been included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Historic Environment (Amendment) Act 2011.

zh.s: 博思韦尔桥战役也称博思韦尔布里格战役，于1679年6月22日爆发。交战双方是政府军和激进的长老会圣约派，这场战斗标志着其短暂叛乱结束。战斗发生在苏格兰南拉纳克郡汉密尔顿、博思韦尔附近的克莱德河桥上。该战场已列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并依照2011年《历史环境（修订）法》受到保护。

en.t: New Hampshire's at-large congressional district special election, 1789
en.s: A special election was held in New Hampshire's at-large congressional district on June 22, 1789 to fill a vacancy left by the resignation of Representative-Elect Benjamin West, who had declined to serve. This was the first special election in the history of the United States House of Representatives.

zh.t: 1789年新罕布什尔州国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 1789年6月22日，新罕布什尔州单一国会选区举行特别选举，以填补当选众议员本杰明·韦斯特辞职留下的空缺。韦斯特拒绝就任。此次是美国众议院历史上的首次特别选举。

en.s: The Battle of Cap-Français took place from 20 to 22 June 1793 during the Haitian Revolution. It was originally a conflict between commissioners sent by the French Republican government, who were supported by rebellious slaves and free people of color, against the colony's elite and white royalist slave owners, who sparked an uprising against the commissioners in the city, led to a military conflict between whites and coloreds within the city, to eventually lead to an attack by slaves throughout the city.

zh.s: 海地角战役于1793年6月20日至22日爆发，属于海地革命。最初交战双方是法国共和政府派出的委员（得到叛乱奴隶和有色自由人的支持），以及殖民地精英和白人保王派奴隶主。后者在城内发动起义，引发白人与有色人种之间的军事冲突，最终又引来奴隶在全城发动袭击。

en.s: The Atlantic raid of June 1796 was a short campaign containing three connected minor naval engagements fought in the Western Approaches comprising Royal Navy efforts to eliminate a squadron of French frigates operating against British commerce during the French Revolutionary Wars. Although Royal Navy dominance in the Western Atlantic had been established, French commerce raiders operating on short cruises were having a damaging effect on British trade, and British frigate squadrons regularly patrolled from Cork in search of the raiders.

zh.s: 1796年6月大西洋突袭是一场短期军事行动，由三场彼此相关的小规模海战组成，发生在大西洋西部航道。英国皇家海军试图消灭一支法国护卫舰编队；该编队在法国大革命战争期间袭击英国商船。虽然英国皇家海军已控制西大西洋，但法国袭击商船的船只仍通过短途航行严重影响英国贸易，英国护卫舰编队也定期从科克出发巡逻，搜寻这些袭击者。

en.s: The Action of 22 June 1803 was a naval battle between the United States Navy and the Tripolitan Navy during the First Barbary War. Two ships from the American squadron blockading Tripoli, USS John Adams and USS Enterprise, met and engaged a Tripolitan polacre along with nine gunboats. After fighting a sharp action for forty five minutes the gunboats veered off and the polacre was abandoned. The Tripolitians later retook the polacre and were reengaged by the Americans before the vessel was destroyed in a large explosion.

zh.s: 1803年6月22日海战是第一次巴巴里战争期间美国海军与的黎波里海军之间的一场海战。美国封锁的黎波里的舰队中，“约翰·亚当斯”号和“企业”号与一艘的黎波里polacre帆船及9艘炮艇交战。激战45分钟后，炮艇撤离，帆船被弃。的黎波里方面后来重新夺回该船，美军再次与其交战，最终船只在一次剧烈爆炸中被毁。

en.s: The Russo-Persian War of 1804–1813 was one of the many wars between the Iranian Empire and Imperial Russia, and, like many of their other conflicts, began as a territorial dispute. The new Persian king, Fath Ali Shah Qajar, wanted to consolidate the northernmost reaches of his kingdom—modern-day Georgia—which had been annexed by Tsar Paul I several years after the Russo-Persian War of 1796.

en.s: The Chesapeake–Leopard affair was a naval engagement off the coast of Norfolk, Virginia, on June 22, 1807, between the British fourth-rate HMS Leopard and the American frigate USS Chesapeake. The crew of Leopard pursued, attacked, and boarded the American frigate, looking for deserters from the Royal Navy. Chesapeake was caught unprepared and after a short battle involving broadsides received from Leopard, the commander of Chesapeake, James Barron, surrendered his vessel to the British.

zh.t: 切萨皮克号与豹号事件
zh.s: 切萨皮克号与豹号事件是1807年6月22日在弗吉尼亚州诺福克海岸外发生的一场海战。英国四级战舰“豹”号追击、攻击并登上美国护卫舰“切萨皮克”号，搜寻英国皇家海军逃兵。“切萨皮克”号毫无防备，在遭到“豹”号侧舷炮击后，舰长詹姆斯·巴伦下令投降。

en.t: 1812 French declaration of war on Russia
en.s: The First French Empire declared war on the Russian Empire on 22 June [O.S. 10 June] 1812, starting Napoleon's invasion two days later. The declaration of war was presented in a diplomatic note by French ambassador Jacques Lauriston to Russian Foreign Minister Alexander Saltykov in Saint Petersburg.

en.s: The Battle of Craney Island was fought on June 22, 1813 during the War of 1812. British forces under George Cockburn and John Borlase Warren attempted an amphibious landing on Craney Island, Virginia but were repulsed by defending American troops under Robert B. Taylor. The battle prevented Norfolk and Portsmouth, two major hubs of American commerce, from coming under British attack.

zh.s: 克雷尼岛战役于1813年6月22日爆发，属于1812年战争。乔治·科克伯恩和约翰·博拉斯·沃伦率领的英军试图在弗吉尼亚州克雷尼岛登陆，但遭罗伯特·B·泰勒指挥的美军击退。这场战斗阻止英军进攻美国商业重镇诺福克和朴次茅斯。

en.s: The Long Expedition was an 1819 attempt to take control of Spanish Texas by filibusters. It was led by James Long and successfully established a small independent government, known as the Republic of Texas (distinct from the later Republic of Texas created by the Texas Revolution). The expedition crumbled later in the year, as Spanish troops drove the invaders out.

en.s: The Battle of Peñacerrada, a battle of the First Carlist War, occurred at Peñacerrada (Urizaharra) on June 20–22, 1838. The Liberals were commanded by Pedro Saarsfield and Manuel Lorenzo, who had crossed the Ebro after the Battle of Los Arcos. They routed 1,500 Carlist troops situated at Peñecerrada. Saarsfield and Lorenzo entered Vitoria-Gasteiz and Bilbao within a week without encountering resistance.

zh.s: 佩尼亚塞拉达战役于1838年6月20日至22日爆发，属于第一次卡洛斯战争。自由派军队由佩德罗·萨尔斯菲尔德和曼努埃尔·洛伦索指挥；他们在洛斯阿尔科斯战役后渡过埃布罗河，在佩尼亚塞拉达击溃了1500名卡洛斯派士兵。不到一周，两位将领的部队就进入维多利亚-加斯泰斯和毕尔巴鄂，途中没有遇到抵抗。

en.s: The Charing Cross, Euston and Hampstead Railway, nicknamed the Hampstead Tube, officially opened in London on June 22, 1907. Board of Trade president David Lloyd George opened the line, and the public could ride free for the rest of the day. Its first route ran from Charing Cross north toward Highgate and Golders Green; the line later became part of the Northern line.
en.n: June 22 is the railway's public opening, not the 1890s founding of the original company.

zh.t: 伦敦汉普斯特德地铁开通
zh.s: 1907年6月22日，伦敦的查令十字—尤斯顿—汉普斯特德铁路正式开通，常被称作“汉普斯特德地铁”。时任英国贸易委员会主席戴维·劳合·乔治主持开通，当天其余时间市民可免费乘车。初期线路从查令十字通往海格特和戈尔德斯格林，后来成为北线的一部分。
zh.n: 6月22日是线路向公众开通的日期，不是铁路公司成立的日期。

en.t: Coronation of George V and Mary
en.s: The coronation of George V and his wife, Mary, as king and queen of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions took place at Westminster Abbey, London, on Thursday 22 June 1911. This was the second of four such events held during the 20th century and the last to be attended by royal representatives of the great continental European empires.

zh.s: 1911年6月22日星期四，乔治五世与妻子玛丽在伦敦威斯敏斯特教堂加冕，成为英国及其自治领的国王和王后。这是20世纪四场同类加冕仪式中的第二场，也是最后一次有欧洲大陆大帝国王室代表出席的加冕礼。

en.s: The Second Battle of Tijuana was fought during the Mexican Revolution in June 1911. The opposing sides were rebel Magonistas and federal Mexican troops of President Francisco León de la Barra with American militia volunteers from Los Angeles, California. Tijuana was retaken by federal forces after a short battle just south of the town.

zh.s: 蒂华纳第二次战役发生于1911年6月墨西哥革命期间。交战双方是马贡主义者叛军，以及弗朗西斯科·莱昂·德拉巴拉总统的墨西哥联邦军和来自加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的美国民兵志愿者。经过镇南的一场短暂战斗，联邦军重新夺回蒂华纳。

en.s: George V (George Frederick Ernest Albert; 3 June 1865 – 20 January 1936) was King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, and Emperor of India, from 6 May 1910 until his death in 1936. George was born during the reign of his paternal grandmother, Queen Victoria, as the second son of the Prince and Princess of Wales (later King Edward VII and Queen Alexandra).

zh.s: 乔治五世（本名乔治·弗雷德里克·欧内斯特·阿尔伯特，1865年6月3日—1936年1月20日）自1910年5月6日起担任英国及自治领国王和印度皇帝，直至1936年去世。他出生时祖母维多利亚女王仍在位，是威尔士亲王与王妃（后来的爱德华七世和亚历山德拉王后）的次子。

en.s: The Hammond circus train wreck occurred on June 22, 1918, and was one of the worst train wrecks in U.S. history. Eighty-six people were reported to have died and another 127 were injured when a locomotive engineer fell asleep and ran his troop train into the rear of a circus train near Hammond, Indiana. The circus train held 400 performers and roustabouts of the Hagenbeck–Wallace Circus.

zh.t: 哈蒙德马戏团列车相撞事故
zh.s: 哈蒙德马戏团列车相撞事故发生于1918年6月22日，是美国历史上最严重的铁路事故之一。火车司机睡着后，驾驶军列撞上印第安纳州哈蒙德附近一列马戏团列车的尾部，造成86人死亡、另有127人受伤。马戏团列车上载有海根贝克-华莱士马戏团的400名表演者和杂工。

en.s: The Twickenham by-election, 1934 was a parliamentary by-election held on 22 June 1934 for the British House of Commons constituency of Twickenham in Middlesex. The seat had become vacant when the constituency's Conservative Member of Parliament (MP), Hylton Murray-Philipson, died on 24 May 1934, aged 31. He had held the seat since a by-election in 1932. The result was a victory for the Conservative candidate Alfred Critchley, who had stood for the Empire Free Trade Crusade and the United Empire Party in the Islington East by-election, 1931 and as a Conservative at the 1929 general election.

zh.s: 1934年特威克纳姆选区补选于1934年6月22日举行，为英国下议院米德尔塞克斯郡特威克纳姆选区选出议员。现任保守党议员希尔顿·默里-菲利普森于1934年5月24日去世，年仅31岁，导致席位空缺；他自1932年一次补选以来一直担任该席位。保守党候选人阿尔弗雷德·克里奇利获胜。他曾代表帝国自由贸易运动和联合帝国党参加1931年伊斯灵顿东区补选，并在1929年大选中以保守党候选人身份参选。

en.s: The French demarcation line was the boundary line marking the division of Metropolitan France into the territory occupied and administered by the German Army (Zone occupée) in the northern and western part of France and the Zone libre (Free zone) in the south during World War II. It was created by the Armistice of 22 June 1940 after the fall of France in May 1940.

en.s: The 1941 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1940–41 Taça de Portugal, the 3rd season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 22 June 1941 at the Campo das Salésias in Lisbon, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Belenenses and Sporting CP.

zh.s: 1941年葡萄牙杯决赛决出了1940—41赛季葡萄牙杯冠军，这是葡萄牙足协主办的顶级足球杯赛第三个赛季。比赛于1941年6月22日在里斯本的萨莱西亚斯球场举行，对阵双方是葡超球队贝伦人和葡萄牙体育。

en.s: Operation Barbarossa was the invasion of the Soviet Union by Nazi Germany and several of its European Axis allies starting on Sunday, 22 June 1941, during World War II. More than 3.8 million Axis troops invaded the western Soviet Union along a 2,900-kilometer (1,800 mi) front, with the main goal of capturing territory up to a line between Arkhangelsk and Astrakhan, known as the A–A line.

zh.s: 巴巴罗萨行动是纳粹德国及多个欧洲轴心国盟友入侵苏联的行动，于第二次世界大战期间的1941年6月22日星期日开始。超过380万名轴心国士兵沿着长达2900公里（1800英里）的战线入侵苏联西部，主要目标是夺取阿尔汉格尔斯克至阿斯特拉罕一线以西的领土，这条界线称为“A-A线”。

en.s: The German-Soviet air war on 22 June 1941 was the largest one-day air battle in military history. The battle involved both aerial dogfights and airstrikes on Soviet airbases. Around 14,000 combat aircraft took part in the air war on 22 June 1941, with more 2,000 combat aircraft destroyed. The loss ratio was estimated at 35:1 to 60:1 in favor of the Luftwaffe.

zh.s: 1941年6月22日德苏空战是军事史上单日规模最大的空战。战斗包括空中格斗和对苏联空军基地的空袭，约有1.4万架作战飞机参战，超过2000架飞机被击毁。苏军与德军的战机损失比估计为35比1至60比1，德国空军占优。

en.s: Operation Renntier was a German operation during World War II intended to secure the nickel mines around Petsamo in Finland, against a Soviet attack in the event of a renewed war between Finland and the Soviet Union. The planning for the operation started on 13 August 1940, after the German occupation of Norway was complete and was finalized in October that year.

zh.s: 1941年6月22日，德国军队在芬兰北部佩察莫地区执行“驯鹿”行动，占据镍矿周边地带，以防苏联在德苏战争爆发后夺取矿区。

en.s: The Soviet submarine Baltic Sea campaign in 1941 was launched by the Soviet Navy at the early stage of Operation Barbarossa. The offensive was hampered by the quick German ground advance and the retreat of Soviet naval vessels from the main Baltic harbors. At the beginning of the conflict the Soviet Navy operated a formidable force on paper, consisting of 75 submarines.

en.s: The Eastern Front, also known as the Great Patriotic War, or the German–Soviet War, was a theatre of World War II fought between the European Axis powers and Allies, including the Soviet Union (USSR) and Poland. It encompassed Central Europe, Eastern Europe, Northeast Europe (Baltics), and Southeast Europe (Balkans), and lasted from 22 June 1941 to 9 May 1945.

zh.t: 巴巴罗萨行动与苏联遭入侵
zh.s: 1941年6月22日，轴心国军队发动巴巴罗萨行动，越过《德苏互不侵犯条约》所划定的边界入侵苏联，第二次世界大战东线战事由此开始。东线战场也称卫国战争或德苏战争，交战双方是欧洲轴心国与包括苏联和波兰在内的盟军，战场涵盖中欧、东欧、东北欧（波罗的海地区）和东南欧（巴尔干地区），持续至1945年5月9日。

en.s: The Battle of Okinawa (Japanese: 沖縄戦, Hepburn: Okinawa-sen), codenamed Operation Iceberg, was a major battle of the Pacific War fought on the island of Okinawa by the United States Army and United States Marine Corps forces against the Imperial Japanese Army. en.t: Campaign of the North China Plain Pocket
en.s: The Campaign of the North China Plain Pocket, also called the Breakout on the Central Plains (Chinese: 中原突围; pinyin: Zhongyuan Tuwei) by the Chinese Communist Party, was a series of battles fought between the nationalists and the communists during the Chinese Civil War, resulting in a successful communist breakout from the nationalist encirclement. The attacks took place: 19 June – dynamite attack at the police station at the Nicosia suburb of Ayios Dhometios; 19 June – bomb set off the central police building at Nicosia 22 June – the police station at Amiandos was attacked by an EOKA guerrilla group led by Renos Kyriakides, resulting in the death of a policeman.

zh.s: 1955年6月，EOKA对塞浦路斯多个警察局发动一系列游击式袭击，引发塞浦路斯紧急状态。袭击包括：6月19日，在尼科西亚郊区圣多梅蒂奥斯警察局发动炸药袭击；6月19日，在尼科西亚中央警察局引爆炸弹；6月22日，由雷诺斯·基里亚基季斯率领的EOKA游击队袭击阿米安多斯警察局，造成一名警察死亡。

en.s: The Pipeline ambush took place during the Malayan Emergency. An Australian patrol of five troops were ambushed by communist forces. A firefight ensued where other Australian troops came to assist. Three Australians were killed making it the most costly Australian involvement of the Emergency.

zh.s: 管线伏击战发生于马来亚紧急状态期间。5名澳大利亚士兵组成的巡逻队遭到共产党武装伏击，随后双方交火，其他澳大利亚士兵赶来支援。3名澳大利亚士兵阵亡，这是澳大利亚在紧急状态期间伤亡最惨重的一次行动。

en.s: The 1959 Fianna Fáil leadership election began in June 1959, when Éamon de Valera resigned as party leader and Taoiseach to take up the post of President of Ireland. It was the first leadership election for the party as De Valera had been leader since the foundation of the party in 1926, and had served as Taoiseach on three occasions. His successor was elected by the members of the Fianna Fáil parliamentary party on 22 June 1959.

zh.s: 1959年6月，埃蒙·德·瓦莱拉辞去爱尔兰共和党党魁和总理职务，出任爱尔兰总统，党内由此开始选举继任者。这是爱尔兰共和党首次举行党魁选举；德·瓦莱拉自1926年建党以来一直担任党魁，并三度出任总理。1959年6月22日，党内议会党团成员选出继任者。

en.s: The 1960 Quebec general election was held on June 22, 1960, to elect members of the Legislative Assembly of Quebec, Canada. It was one of the most significant elections in Quebec history, rivalled perhaps only by the 1976 general election. The incumbent Union Nationale, led by Antonio Barrette, was defeated by the Quebec Liberal Party, led by Jean Lesage.

zh.s: 1960年魁北克省大选于1960年6月22日举行，选出加拿大魁北克省立法议会议员。这是魁北克历史上最重要的选举之一，可能只有1976年大选可与之相比。由安东尼奥·巴雷特领导的执政民族联盟党败给让·勒萨日领导的魁北克自由党。

en.s: Air France Flight 117 was a multi-leg international scheduled flight operated by a Boeing 707 from Paris-Orly Airport via Lisbon, the Azores, Guadeloupe and Peru to Santiago, Chile, which crashed on 22 June 1962 killing 113 people. This was the second accident in less than three weeks with an Air France Boeing 707 after the crash on 3 June 1962.

zh.s: 法国航空117号班机是一条多段国际定期航线，由波音707执飞，从巴黎奥利机场出发，经里斯本、亚速尔群岛、瓜德罗普和秘鲁飞往智利圣地亚哥。飞机于1962年6月22日坠毁，113人遇难。这是不到三周内发生的第二起法国航空波音707事故；此前一架同型飞机于1962年6月3日坠毁。

en.s: The communist insurgency in Sarawak was an insurgency in Malaysia from 1962 to 1990, and involved the North Kalimantan Communist Party (NKCP) and the Malaysian Government. It was one of the two communist insurgencies to challenge the former British colony of Malaysia during the Cold War. As with the earlier Malayan Emergency (1948–1960), the communist insurgents in Sarawak were predominantly ethnic Chinese, who opposed British rule over Sarawak and later opposed the merger of the state into the newly created Federation of Malaysia.

en.s: The Buddhist Uprising of 1966 (Vietnamese: Nổi dậy Phật giáo 1966), or more widely known in Vietnam as the Crisis in Central Vietnam (Biến động Miền Trung), was a period of civil and military unrest in South Vietnam, mostly in the I Corps area in the north of the country in central Vietnam.
en.n: Vietnamese Buddhist activist leader Thích Trí Quang was arrested as the military junta of Nguyen Cao Ky crushed the Buddhist Uprising.

zh.s: 1966年佛教徒起义（越南语：Nổi dậy Phật giáo 1966），在越南更常称“中部越南危机”（Biến động Miền Trung），是南越一段社会和军事动荡时期，主要发生在南越北部、今越南中部的第一军区。
zh.n: 军事执政团在阮高祺领导下镇压佛教徒起义期间，佛教活动领袖释智光遭到逮捕。

en.s: The 1969 Taça de Portugal final was the final match of the 1968–69 Taça de Portugal, the 29th season of the Taça de Portugal, the premier Portuguese football cup competition organized by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF). The match was played on 22 June 1969 at the Estádio Nacional in Oeiras, and opposed two Primeira Liga sides: Académica and Benfica.

en.t: The Cuyahoga River catches fire in Cleveland, Ohio, drawing national attention to water pollution, and spurring the passing of the Clean Water Act and the creation of the Environmental Protection Agency
en.s: The Cuyahoga River (see § Pronunciation) is a river located in Northeast Ohio that feeds into Lake Erie. The Cuyahoga River bisects the city of Cleveland. As Cleveland emerged as a major manufacturing center, the river became heavily affected by industrial pollution, so much so that it caught fire at least 14 times. When it did so on June 22, 1969, news coverage of the event helped to spur the American environmental movement.

zh.t: 凯霍加河在克利夫兰起火，引起全国对水污染的关注，并推动《清洁水法》通过和环境保护署成立
zh.s: 凯霍加河位于俄亥俄州东北部，流入伊利湖，并穿过克利夫兰市。随着克利夫兰发展为重要制造业中心，河流受到严重工业污染，至少起火14次。1969年6月22日河水再次起火，相关报道推动了美国环保运动的发展。

en.s: The Corrective Move was a political shift that took place in South Yemen on 22 June 1969, resulting in the overthrow and purge of the ruling right-wing faction of the National Front (NF) by the party's left-wing faction. The change in leadership was followed by the adoption of a series of socialist policies and reforms, and marked South Yemen's transition into a communist state.

zh.s: 纠偏运动是1969年6月22日在南也门发生的一次政治转向。民族阵线左翼推翻并清洗了党内执政右翼派系。领导层更替后，政府推行了一系列社会主义政策和改革，南也门由此转向共产主义国家。

Operation Phalat established a base camp at Xieng Lom, Laos, on the southern bank of the Mekong River, and garrisoned it with three Thai mercenary battalions.

en.t: East Germany v West Germany (1974 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: On 22 June 1974, East Germany played West Germany in Hamburg as part of the first group stage of the 1974 FIFA World Cup. East Germany won the match 1–0, in what is regarded as one of the greatest upsets in FIFA World Cup history. The match is also the only time East and West Germany ever played each other in top-level senior international competition.

zh.s: 1974年6月22日，东德在汉堡对阵西德，比赛属于1974年国际足联世界杯第一阶段小组赛。东德以1比0获胜，被视为世界杯历史上最令人意外的胜利之一。这也是东德和西德在成年国家队顶级国际赛事中唯一一次交锋。

en.t: Charon, the first of Pluto's satellites to be discovered, was first seen at the United States Naval Observatory by James W. Christy
en.s: Charon ( KAIR-on, -⁠ən or SHARR-ən), formal designation (134340) Pluto I, is the largest of the five known natural satellites of the dwarf planet Pluto. It has a mean radius of 606 km (377 mi). Charon is a planetary-mass moon and the sixth-largest known trans-Neptunian object after Pluto, Eris, Haumea, Makemake, and Gonggong.

en.s: The UEFA Euro 1980 final was the final match of UEFA Euro 1980, the sixth European Championship, UEFA's top football competition for national teams. The match was played at the Stadio Olimpico in Rome, Italy, on 22 June 1980, and was contested between Belgium and West Germany. En route to the final, Belgium finished top of their qualifying group, before reaching the final as winners of the tournament's Group 2, which included Italy, England and Spain.

zh.s: 1980年欧洲足球锦标赛决赛是该届赛事的最后一场比赛，也是欧洲国家队最高级别足球赛事的第六届决赛。比赛于1980年6月22日在意大利罗马奥林匹克体育场举行，对阵双方是比利时和西德。比利时先在预选赛小组中排名第一，随后又在包括意大利、英格兰和西班牙的第二组中胜出，晋级决赛。

en.t: Virgin Atlantic launches with its first flight from London to Newark
en.s: Virgin Atlantic, a trading name of Virgin Atlantic Airways Limited and Virgin Atlantic International Limited, is a British airline with its head office in Crawley, West Sussex, England. The airline was established in 1984 as British Atlantic Airways, and was originally planned by its co-founders Randolph Fields and Alan Hellary to fly between London and the Falkland Islands.

zh.t: 维珍大西洋航空开通首航
zh.s: 维珍大西洋航空是英国航空公司，运营主体为维珍大西洋航空有限公司和维珍大西洋国际有限公司，总部位于西萨塞克斯郡克劳利。该公司于1984年以“英国大西洋航空”之名成立，联合创办人伦道夫·菲尔兹和艾伦·赫拉里最初计划开通伦敦至福克兰群岛的航线。

en.s: The 1986 Spanish general election was held on Sunday, 22 June 1986, to elect the 3rd Cortes Generales of the Kingdom of Spain. All 350 seats in the Congress of Deputies were up for election, as well as 208 of 254 seats in the Senate. The election was held after the referendum on Spanish membership in NATO in March 1986 had resulted in a surprising win for the 'In' camp headed by Prime Minister Felipe González. Reinforced from the referendum result, the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party (PSOE) sought to take advantage of the favorable political situation.

zh.s: 1986年西班牙大选于6月22日星期日举行，选出西班牙王国第三届议会。众议院350席和参议院254席中的208席开放竞选。1986年3月有关西班牙是否继续留在北约的公投中，支持留在北约的一方意外获胜。总理费利佩·冈萨雷斯领导的西班牙工人社会党借助公投结果带来的政治优势，希望把握有利局面。

en.t: Argentina v England (1986 FIFA World Cup)
en.s: The Argentina 2–1 England quarter-final match of the 1986 FIFA World Cup was a football match played on 22 June 1986 between Argentina and England at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City. The match was held four years after the end of the Falklands War between Argentina and the United Kingdom, and was a key part of the already intense Argentina–England football rivalry.

zh.s: 1986年国际足联世界杯四分之一决赛中，阿根廷以2比1击败英格兰。比赛于1986年6月22日在墨西哥城的阿兹特克体育场举行，距英阿马岛战争结束四年，也是英阿足球宿敌对决中的关键一战。

The former president of the Regional Government of Andalusia Rafael Escuredo had been replaced in the post by José Rodríguez de la Borbolla in March 1984.

zh.s: 安达卢西亚于1986年6月22日举行自治区选举，选出自治区议会第二届议员，109个席位全部改选。选举与1986年西班牙大选同时举行。安达卢西亚自治区政府前主席拉斐尔·埃斯库雷多已于1984年3月由何塞·罗德里格斯·德拉博尔沃利亚接替。

en.s: The 1991 DFB-Pokal final decided the winner of the 1990–91 DFB-Pokal, the 48th season of Germany's premier knockout football cup competition. zh.s: 1991年德国杯决赛决出了1990—91赛季德国杯冠军，这是德国顶级淘汰制足球杯赛的第48个赛季。比赛于1991年6月22日在柏林奥林匹克体育场举行。云达不来梅与科隆在加时赛后战成1比1，云达不来梅随后在点球大战中以4比3获胜，第二次夺得德国杯。球队因此获得1991—92赛季欧洲优胜者杯和1991年德国超级杯的参赛资格。

en.s: Hardcore Heaven (1996) was the third Hardcore Heaven professional wrestling event produced by Extreme Championship Wrestling (ECW). en.t: 2025 United States strikes on Iranian nuclear sites
en.s: On June 22, 2025, the United States Air Force and Navy attacked three nuclear facilities in Iran as part of the Twelve-Day War, under the code name Operation Midnight Hammer. The Fordow Uranium Enrichment Plant, the Natanz Nuclear Facility, and the Isfahan Nuclear Technology Center were targeted with fourteen GBU-57A/B MOP "bunker buster" bombs carried by B-2 Spirit stealth bombers, and Tomahawk missiles fired from a submarine.
